narr: A frontal boundary slowly pushed through the area during the evening hours. A line of storms along a cold front produced intense rainfall in coastal Mississippi that lead to flash flooding.
ev: A spotter report of flash flooding was confirmed by a social media video showing vehicles stalled in high waters near the intersection of Lee Street and Highway 90 in Biloxi.
lsr: SPOTTER REPORT AND SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO OF STALLED VEHICLES FROM DRIVING THROUGH FLOODED ROADS AT THE CORNER OF LEE STREET AND HIGHWAY 90 IN BILOXI.
